mintAuthority.summary: nOPAL has independent native issuance on Ethereum, Plume, BSC, and Plasma. On each native deployment, the nOPAL BoringVault is owned by the Nest Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a (172,800-second minimum delay), while the Teller and Manager are owned by the same current 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982; fresh 2026-09-05 Plasma reads confirm the same graph there, including the Manager's vault() linkage and the Safe holding proposer and canceller roles on the Plasma Timelock. The Plasma deployment is live per the issuer registry but dormant, with zero supply at the reviewed block, and the Plasma Safe's modules state could not be read this pass, so no Plasma Safe control row is authored. These are native issuance controls on four independent liability surfaces, not bridge-admin controls; issuance remains unbounded and no independent whole-supply reconciliation or prudential supervision was found.

review.evidence: Reviewed 2026-08-16 across the complete native scope: Nest's current vault registry identifies the nOPAL share token and Teller, while verified Manager contracts on Ethereum, Plume, and BSC return the nOPAL deployment from vault(); direct owner() reads confirm the same per-chain control graph. The nOPAL token owner Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a returned a 172800-second minimum delay on all three chains; the 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 is the current proposer and canceller on each Timelock, with no enabled Safe modules. Fixed observations on 2026-08-16 recorded nonzero totalSupply on Ethereum (19,094,202.277440 at block 25770421), Plume (12,981,544.220067 at block 87678480), and BSC (13,997,699.499774 at block 116347230). These are three independent native liabilities; the route inventory's Plume and BSC rows are native-issuance routes, not bridge representations. Nest's issuer-operated hourly NAV, live vault composition, and flow-of-funds pages do not provide independent recurring reconciliation of total nOPAL liabilities across deployments, and Nest DAO LLC is not a prudentially supervised fund issuer. No public bridge topology, OFT, lockbox, adapter, or destination-token mint role was identified. The owner Safe controls the Teller and Manager issuance path, and the owner Timelock can call the owner-authenticated BoringVault enter() path; no economic cap was verified. The existing evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, with the latest public vault-data snapshot dated 2026-07-08, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nOPAL supply to portfolio assets was found. Nest DAO LLC is a Marshall Islands DAO LLC, not a prudentially supervised fund issuer. Wave 2 external review 2026-08-15: Nest's live positions, price, NAV, vault, flow-of-funds, and terms pages remain issuer-operated, and no reserve-attestor report was found that independently reconciles total nOPAL liabilities across deployments. Reconciliation review 2026-08-15: Nest's dated Available Vaults snapshot describes nOPAL as a multi-asset vault share and its Audits register lists smart-contract audits, but no named third-party report or recurring attestation reconciling total nOPAL liabilities across its EVM and Solana deployments to the portfolio was found; the available evidence therefore remains insufficient for periodic reconciliation. U5 Plasma closeout 2026-09-05: Plasma native coverage added. At Plasma block 31652535 the nOPAL token read 'Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault'/nOPAL/6 decimals/totalSupply 0 with owner() the Nest Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a and an empty EIP-1967 implementation slot; at block 31654043 the Teller and Manager owner() reads returned the 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982, Manager vault() returned the Plasma token, the Timelock returned a 172,800-second minimum delay with the Safe as proposer and canceller, and the Plasma USDT NestVault 0x5e949fa6401d7c49cdcb48e3a8bdc28f60657a2c owner() returned the Nest Timelock. The Plasma Safe singleton (slot 0) is 0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea (v1.3.0 L1) with a zero guard slot, but getModulesPaginated reads on Plasma reverted, so the Plasma Safe's modules state is an explicit gap and no Plasma Safe control row is authored; bridge-representation chains (World Chain, Avalanche, Solana) are out of mint-authority scope and no bridge-only controls were added.
